authors: Vaithilingam, Zhang, Glassman
year: 2022
venue: CHI EA
method: experiment
summary: Within-subjects user study comparing Copilot with a traditional autocomplete on three programming tasks. | 被试内用户研究：在三个编程任务上比较 Copilot 与传统自动补全。
---
- counter | RQ1 | Abstract | opposing result | Copilot did not necessarily improve task completion time or success rate. | Copilot 并不一定缩短完成时间或提高成功率。
- evidence | RQ3 | Abstract | moderate | Most participants still preferred to use Copilot in daily programming. | 大多数参与者仍然更愿意在日常编程中使用 Copilot。
- evidence | RQ2 | Abstract | moderate | Participants had trouble understanding, editing and debugging the generated code. | 参与者难以理解、修改和调试生成的代码。
